source: Fortnite.GG news archive (https://fortnite.gg/news) of Epic's official Fortnite news

items.title: One Piece's Buggy Makes Landfall
items.desc: A new Captain has claimed territory! Defeat the Buggy Boss, claim the Transponder Snail Sprite, and explode into action with the Special Buggy Ball.

items.title: Level Up with Quests
items.desc: Completing Quests is the fastest way to earn XP and unlock Battle Pass rewards! Track active Quests to monitor progress during matches, and manage up to 25 Quests in the My Tracked Quests category.

items.title: Find Your New Favorite in Discover
items.desc: Use Discover to browse hundreds of game modes, from Epic-made experiences like Battle Royale to community-created Islands with popular collaborations. Save favorites to easily find them again, follow developers, and stay on top of the latest updates with Community Highlights. Your next favorite game is waiting!

items.title: Lil Uzi Vert Drops Anchor
items.desc: Set sail for Uzi's Stronghold and face the Lil Uzi Vert Boss, take aim with Lil Uzi Vert's Lil' SMG, and extract the Lil' Uzi Vert Jr. Sprite!

items.title: Lil Uzi Vert Drops Anchor
items.desc: A new Captain has sailed in! Face the Lil Uzi Vert Boss to earn Lil' Uzi Vert Jr., and get ahead with the lightning-fast Lil Uzi Vert's Lil' SMG.

items.title: Live - One Piece: Zoro Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Duos Battle Royale or the Duos Zero Build One Piece: Zoro Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Roronoa Zoro Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Fortune Sprite Variants - November 7
items.desc: Set sail for sparkling Sprites from 2-4 PM ET and 9-11 PM ET! Drop in with A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket and a Self Revive, and find more Fortune Sprite variants across the Island.

items.title: Devil Fruits Across the Island
items.desc: Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map! Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy, or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace... just stay away from water.

items.title: Straw Hats Arsenal Live
items.desc: Ready your weapons, adventurers! Wield Zoro's Three Sword Style, take aim with Usopp's Slingshot, and heal up with Meat on a Stick or Nami's Tangerine.

items.title: Adventure Awaits!
items.desc: Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay, or storm The $.$. Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.

items.title: Two Ways to Battle Royale
items.desc: Find your path to Victory! In Builds, gather materials with your Pickaxe and construct structures on the fly to outmaneuver opponents and gain the high ground. In Zero Build, focus on combat and movement with reusable Pocket Items, Glider Redeploy, and infinite sprint when holding a Pickaxe.

items.title: Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits
items.desc: When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer! Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.

items.title: Multi-Punches Flex
items.desc: GUM-GUM GATLING!

items.title: A$AP Rocky Sails In
items.desc: A new Captain has taken over part of the Island! Face the A$AP Rocky Boss to earn Lil' Flacko, and blast away the competition with the A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket.

items.title: Day-o Emote
items.desc: Dance like daylight is coming.

items.title: Keep Tabs on the Adventure!
items.desc: All great adventures begin with a treasure map! Head to the Treasure Tab to follow along with weekly progress and chart your next move.

items.title: Treasure Hunters Is Live
items.desc: Adventure awaits! Cross paths with the Straw Hats and A$AP Rocky's Crew this week, with new Crews landing in the weeks to come.

items.title: Unlock the Dark Kawaii Team Leader Style
items.desc: Gifting the Treasure Hunters Battle Pass unlocks the Dark Kawaii Team Leader Style and matching Accessories for both the gifter and the friend receiving it!

items.title: Bring Your Squad Back From the Brink
items.desc: All hope is not lost when a teammate goes down! When they fall, they leave behind a Reboot Card. Pick it up, take it to a Reboot Van, and bring them back into the fight for a better shot at victory.

items.title: Rarer Color, Better Weapons!
items.desc: Weapons come in five rarities: Gray (Common), Green (Uncommon), Blue (Rare), Purple (Epic), and Orange (Legendary). Higher rarity means better stats, so open Chests and swap out weapons when finding something better!

items.title: The Slender Man Outfit
items.desc: From the darkness, a blank face watches. Suit up as the internet legend in The Slender Man Outfit.

items.title: Treasure Hunters - November 1
items.desc: Chests to crack. Sprites to extract. Treasure to claim. The greatest treasure hunt of all time lands on November 1.

items.title: Two Ways to Play
items.desc: Find the Battle Royale experience that fits! Standard Battle Royale lets players collect resources and build walls, ramps, and structures on the fly. Zero Build removes building, so players can focus on combat and movement. Zero Build is a great place to start!

items.title: Land Smart to Start Strong
items.desc: At the start of each match, drop from the Battle Bus and aim for a less crowded area. This gives time to loot and gear up before the fight begins… unless you want to kick things off with a bang!

items.title: Play Defense with Health and Shields
items.desc: Keeping track of Shields and Health is critical to survival. Grab and consume Shield Potions as soon as possible, as low Shields means going down faster in a fight. Use healing items like Med Kits to recover Health between encounters, preferably before the next battle begins!

items.title: Open Chests for the Best Loot
items.desc: Valuable Chests are scattered across the Island and contain healing items, weapons, and more, with different rarities of Chests providing different qualities of loot. Listen for the shimmering audio cue to track them down!

items.title: Live - NAC - FNCS Solos Finals
items.desc: Jump into Legends Landing and watch top Battle Royale Solos compete for the title of FNCS Champion in FNCS Solos now!

items.title: Live - EU - FNCS Solos Finals
items.desc: Jump into Legends Landing and watch top Battle Royale Solos compete for the title of FNCS Champion in FNCS Solos now!

items.title: Live - Inoxtag Icon Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Duos Battle Royale or the Duos Zero Build Inoxtag Icon Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Inoxtag Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Live - HamiKuma Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Trios Battle Royale or the Trios Zero Build HamiKuma Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the HamiKuma Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Live - Mobile Series Championship
items.desc: Jump into Legends Landing and watch top Mobile Reload Solos compete for the chance to be crowned Mobile Series Champion in Copenhagen, Denmark now!

items.title: Live - Slender Man Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Duos Reload or the Duos Zero Build Slender Man Cup now! Top regional performers will receive The Slender Man Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Live - Champion Teal Knight FNCS Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Solo Battle Royale or the Solo Zero Build Champion Teal Knight FNCS Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the FNCS Teal Knight Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Live - Lady Liberty Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Solo Battle Royale or the Solo Zero Build Lady Liberty Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Lady Liberty Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Horrors Worth Facing Together
items.desc: Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares! Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist. Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.

items.title: Live - Elite Kado Thorne Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Solo Reload Elite Kado Thorne Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Elite Kado Thorne Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Live - Street Fighter Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Duos Reload or the Duos Zero Build Street Fighter Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Chun-Li Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Boosted Bounty Hunter Sprites
items.desc: Track down Bounty Hunter Sprites that are showing up all over the Island, and aim true with the fast-firing Dual Fiend Hunter crossbows dropping in every match.

items.title: Horde Rush Returns
items.desc: Rack up a new high score by eliminating waves of Monsters, find score multipliers, and earn combos in the fast-paced Horde Rush. Defeat the Final Peel to unlock an endless mode and push the high score to the limit!

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Gameplay
items.desc: It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale, with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor. Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.

items.title: Level Up in Horde Rush
items.desc: Push further with every wave! Take down Monsters, climb the ranks, and unlock powerful perks along the way. Fight all the way to the Final Peel to survive this chilling challenge.

items.title: Boosted Bounty Hunter Sprites in Power Hour
items.desc: Take aim and lock on during Power Hour! Bounty Hunter Sprites will appear more often, and powerful, fast-firing Dual Fiend Hunter crossbows await in every match. Live October 3 at 2-4 PM ET and 9-11 PM ET.

items.title: Krueger Specials Kicks
items.desc: Step onto Elm Street in the sinisterly stylish Krueger Specials Kicks!

items.title: Morgana (P5R) Sidekick
items.desc: He's NOT a cat! Pick up Morgana (P5R) in the Shop and equip him as your Sidekick to earn Sidekick Points that unlock unique cosmetics and rewards.

items.title: The Horror Is Here
items.desc: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches. Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await, including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!

items.title: Morgana Bus
items.desc: Transform! Explore battlefields and beyond with the Morgana Bus vehicle, available in Battle Royale and Rocket League.

items.title: Live - Persona 5 Royal Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Solo Reload Persona 5 Royal Cup or the Solo Zero Build Persona 5 Royal Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Joker (P5R) Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Fortnitemares Returns October 1
items.desc: Press start to begin terror! Fortnitemares returns to Battle Royale on October 1.

items.desc: It's a dangerous kind of crush.

items.desc: Let the confetti fly.

items.title: New Bounty Hunter Sprites Are Here!
items.desc: New Bounty Hunter Sprites are live, so let the hunt begin! Find them, extract them, and test out the new Infinite Ammo and Vampirism Overrides.

items.title: Boosted Hacker Sprites Are Here
items.desc: Answer the call with Kingdom Hearts items including the Kingdom Key and Sea Salt Ice Cream, and hunt down more Hacker Sprites all across the Island! Active from 2-4 PM ET and 9-11 PM ET.

items.title: Welcome to Gotham City!
items.desc: Swing into action with Batman’s Grapnel Gun and Batarang as Gotham City lands in OG.

items.title: Live - KINGDOM HEARTS Cup
items.desc: Compete in the Solo Battle Royale or the Solo Zero Build KINGDOM HEARTS Cup now! Participate and earn 8 points to acquire the Glowing Keyhole Spray. Top regional performers will receive the Sora Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.
